name: Carrion crow
lateFeature: Pale-edged slate wing tiers, broad flight feathers and heavy toes
anatomyNotes: Black feathered bill base, dark eye, low rounded crown and sturdy bill. Broad rounded tail and powerful feet differ from the pointed-crowned bare-faced rook.
